VINK·LOOP

A feedback loop after Jaap Vink: ring modulator, filters, tape and delay, fed by a microphone or by its own noise. Silent until you start it. The microphone only listens while you hold its button. Use headphones: with speakers the room closes a second loop.

Hold the button (or the M key) to listen; let go and it is silent. Raw capture, no echo cancellation.
